label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: 5 questions to ask instead of *“How was your day?”*
cover.sub: Small questions that get real answers.

points.heading: Ask about the best part
points.body: “Fine” is the answer to a closed question. This one asks for a story.
points.panel: “What was the best part of your day?”

points.heading: Ask what was heavy
points.body: Let him set something down without either of you having to fix it.
points.panel: “What took the most out of you today?”

points.heading: Ask about what’s ahead
points.body: Looking forward together is a quiet way of saying you’re on the same team.
points.panel: “What are you looking forward to this week?”

points.heading: Ask what he’s thinking about
points.body: People rarely get asked this. It can open a door that small talk walks right past.

points.heading: Ask how you can help
points.body: A simple offer, with no scorekeeping attached.
points.panel: “Is there anything I can take off your plate?”

caption:
“How was your day?” “Fine.” And that’s the whole conversation.

The question isn’t wrong. It’s just worn smooth. A slightly different one can get a slightly longer answer, and longer answers are where you start to hear each other again.

Try one tonight. Save this so you have them handy, and follow @spotseason for more.
